audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 through 6 were all given to Gwen at 2/10 while every whys[] line beside them says the stage is even or skill-dependent, and two-plus items was given to Yorick while whys[6] says Gwen out-duels and out-splits you there.
audit.why: The packet reads Skill for rows 0-4 and Gwen for rows 5-6, which is also what the prose says and what a 47.23% win rate over 1029 games looks like — an even lane that she takes over on items.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 to Skill at 5/10, row 6 to Gwen at 3/10, as matched full/content pairs. diffRating 8.5/10 to 6/10 with diff and the two lines quoting the number brought along; the mirror rated its own side 4/10.

audit.why: Her first item as the real spike is right, and it is where the chart now flips.
audit.corrected: Kept; Hallowed Mist's 22s at rank 1 added as the concrete number the advice was missing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Needlework is called her Q in four places. Needlework is her R — three casts of slowing needles. Her Q is Snip Snip!. Separately, the page treats Hallowed Mist as blanket immunity to the swarm.
audit.why: Riot's own text says the mist protects her from enemies outside of it and that she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. Mist Walkers that walk in can keep attacking her, and Mourning Mist's mark is what speeds them toward her — so the counter is to send the swarm in, not to wait 22 seconds. Snip Snip! also deals true damage down its centre, which is why 'build MR' alone reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Real slot names used, the enter-the-mist rule stated with the swarm as the answer, and the true-damage core noted against the MR advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page leads with 'build MR' and mentions Executioner's only in a boilerplate itemization line.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her off champion damage on every auto, and Skip 'n Slash gives attack speed and applies on-hit — so attack-speed-scaled damage plus healing, not raw magic damage, is what the trade actually is.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds put ahead of more MR in breakdown.mid.

edits.before: Even at 6 it's a skill fight: your Maiden pressures her, but her Hallowed Mist (W) lets her ignore your ghouls while she stays inside it, so bait the W or fight at its edge.
edits.after: Even at 6 it's a skill fight: she is untargetable from outside Hallowed Mist, but anything inside can hit her — send the swarm in on a Mourning Mist mark instead of waiting out the 22s.

edits.before: Gwen's first item is her real spike — Needlework (Q) shreds your ghouls and % health, and her W plus E dodge your whole squad, so she wins the extended duel here.

edits.before: Level 6 stays a skill matchup: your Maiden threatens her, but Hallowed Mist (W) lets her simply stand in the fog and ignore ghouls, so your damage only lands if you force her out of or to the edge of the W.
edits.after: Level 6 stays a skill matchup. Hallowed Mist only protects her from enemies outside it — mark her with Mourning Mist and your Mist Walkers walk into the fog and keep swinging while you work its edge. It is 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: Once Gwen buys her first item she pulls ahead for good — Needlework (Q) melts your ghouls and health while W and E dodge the swarm, so stop dueling and instead group, letting ghouls chip her in fights where she can't fog every source of damage.
edits.after: Once Gwen buys her first item she pulls ahead for good — Snip Snip! melts ghouls and health while Hallowed Mist and Skip 'n Slash dodge the swarm, and Needlework is her R, three casts of slowing needles. Stop dueling: group and let ghouls chip her from inside the fog.
